title: Salt Pete tells you about your boat

nodes.speaker: Salt Pete
nodes.text: There’s more to the Nivalis oceans than sentient slime, junk HOVA’s and ancient, God-like AI’s that lie dreaming dark dreams.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There’s more to the Nivalis oceans than sentient slime, junk HOVA’s and ancient, God-like AI’s that lie dreaming dark dreams.

nodes.speaker: Salt Pete
nodes.text: I thought you were the new Mariner?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I thought you were the new Mariner?

nodes.speaker: Salt Pete
nodes.text: You've seen "The Putter?" The boat over there?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You've seen "The Putter?" The boat over there?

nodes.speaker: Salt Pete
nodes.text: Wait, did you tell ole Crabface you're the new Mariner yet?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, did you tell ole Crabface you're the new Mariner yet?

nodes.speaker: Salt Pete
nodes.text: I wonder what he thinks about all that rust on your boat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wonder what he thinks about all that rust on your boat.

nodes.speaker: Salt Pete
nodes.text: Sure! It's yours. I mean as long as you've stepped aboard once. You have stepped aboard, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure! It's yours. I mean as long as you've stepped aboard once. You have stepped aboard, right?

nodes.speaker: Salt Pete
nodes.text: Well technically the Putter belongs to me, Crabface and Foamheart, but I owned the original engine, and that's been replaced.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well technically the Putter belongs to me, Crabface and Foamheart, but I owned the original engine, and that's been replaced.

nodes.speaker: Salt Pete
nodes.text: Right. And the next person who gets onboard can claim it... if they register with the Shipping Guild. That's why I reckon you're the new Mariner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. And the next person who gets onboard can claim it... if they register with the Shipping Guild. That's why I reckon you're the new Mariner.

nodes.speaker: Salt Pete
nodes.text: I like your legs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like your legs.

nodes.speaker: Salt Pete
nodes.text: Those are sea legs if ever I saw em. I got good eyes. I know most of the folks round here couldn't handle a boat like The Putter. But you could. I bet Thaddeus thought the same.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Those are sea legs if ever I saw em. I got good eyes. I know most of the folks round here couldn't handle a boat like The Putter. But you could. I bet Thaddeus thought the same.

nodes.speaker: Salt Pete
nodes.text: Well, I got a few goals left on my bucket list, and maybe I can tell you about one of them. But not now. Take the boat out for a sail first. We'll talk once you're the registered Captain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I got a few goals left on my bucket list, and maybe I can tell you about one of them. But not now. Take the boat out for a sail first. We'll talk once you're the registered Captain.

nodes.speaker: Salt Pete
nodes.text: You're welcome young Mariner. Take the boat out for a sail. We'll talk again once you're the registered Captain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're welcome young Mariner. Take the boat out for a sail. We'll talk again once you're the registered Captain.

nodes.speaker: Salt Pete
nodes.text: It's yours. I mean as long as you've stepped aboard once. You have stepped aboard, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's yours. I mean as long as you've stepped aboard once. You have stepped aboard, right?

nodes.speaker: Salt Pete
nodes.text: Foamheart owns the hull, but that got eaten up by rust and every inch got resurfaced. Crabface had the ship license, but that lapsed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Foamheart owns the hull, but that got eaten up by rust and every inch got resurfaced. Crabface had the ship license, but that lapsed.

nodes.speaker: Salt Pete
nodes.text: Come back in a few days and see me when you've got some salt in your hair. I got a few goals left on my bucket list, and maybe you can help me with one of em.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Come back in a few days and see me when you've got some salt in your hair. I got a few goals left on my bucket list, and maybe you can help me with one of em.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why were you calling me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why were you calling me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ... I could be a Mariner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... I could be a Mariner.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "MY" boat?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "MY" boat?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you had a boat but it's not yours anymore?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you had a boat but it's not yours anymore?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you had a boat but it's not yours anymore?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you had a boat but it's not yours anymore?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Uh... thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Uh... thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...I like your legs too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...I like your legs too.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I get a boat. So what's in it for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I get a boat. So what's in it for you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I get a boat. So what's in it for you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I get a boat. So what's in it for you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ok Pete.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok Pete.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How could I forget Crabface?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How could I forget Crabface?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Crabface mentioned a license?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Crabface mentioned a license?
